svg.title: Insurance claims triage — complete project architecture
svg.desc: Synthetic JSON and CSV claims enter through Streamlit and authenticated FastAPI, or through the Python CLI directly into the application service. The supervisor routes to intake, a validation checkpoint, coverage and anomaly analysis, and adjuster briefing. Invalid claims skip coverage. Versioned knowledge and SQLite support the service. Every recommendation waits for a human decision. A runtime port serves all four roles through the default local mock or the Azure Foundry adapter; live Azure verification is pending.
svg.text: From claim intake to an evidence-backed human decision
Python application / Four agent roles / Azure AI Foundry adapter
Owns ordering, tool execution, validation checkpoints and review state

Model text cannot override a checkpoint.
